question: Who is the Union Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports, as of March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Thakur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anurag Thakur:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian politician currently serving as the Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting and Youth Affairs and Sports in the Government of India.**
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been a Member of Parliament (MP) from Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh since 2008.
 
• **Thakur is an avid sports enthusiast and has served as the president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) from 2015 to 2017.**
 
• He is also the president of the Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association (HPCA).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **S Jaishankar:-**

 
 
• **He is the current Minister of External Affairs of India. **
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been a Member of Parliament (MP) from Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, since 2014.
 
 
 
• **Smriti Irani:-**
 
 
• **She is the current Minister for Women and Child Development and Minister for Minority Affairs of India. **
 
• She is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been a Member of Parliament (MP) from Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, since 2019.
 
 
 
• **Kiren Rijiju:-**
 
 
• **He is the current Minister of Law and Justice and Minister of Justice of India. **
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has been a Member of Parliament (MP) from Arunachal West, Arunachal Pradesh, since 2004.
